[EN] Mission Orders

The tuwangis in Babok Hollow are resisting our efforts to explore the mire.

Kill the {@LinkCreature:5#1#tuwangi overseers}, {@LinkCreature:5#2#tuwangi helpers}, and {@LinkCreature:5#3#tuwangi workers}.

Report to Zandra in Lumbertown when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los tuwangis en Babok Hollow se oponen a nuestros esfuerzos por explorar el pantano.

Mata a los {@LinkCreature:5#1#tuwangi overseers}, {@LinkCreature:5#2#tuwangi helpers} y {@LinkCreature:5#3#tuwangi workers}.

Preséntate ante Zandra en Lumbertown cuando completes la misión.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
